components.name: Button
components.description: A control that starts an action, named by its label.

icon.description: An icon that makes the action quicker to spot. Without a label, the button needs an accessible name from the consumer.

spinner.description: Shown while the action runs, drawn over the label and icon so the button keeps its size.

components.name: ButtonIcon
components.description: The icon a button carries beside its label.

components.name: ButtonLabel
components.description: The text that names the action.

components.name: ButtonSpinner
components.description: The busy mark shown while the action runs.
